sentences.l2: 青少年运动损伤急救包很重要。
sentences.l1: A first-aid kit for teenage sports injuries is very important.

sentences.l2: 运动时，我们可能会受伤，比如摔倒或者扭伤。
sentences.l1: When doing sports, we may get hurt, for example by falling or spraining.

sentences.l2: 这时候，急救包就能帮我们。
sentences.l1: At this time, the first-aid kit can help us.

sentences.l2: 一个好的急救包里应该有创可贴，用来贴在小伤口上。
sentences.l1: A good first-aid kit should have adhesive bandages, used for sticking on small wounds.

sentences.l2: 还有消毒湿巾，可以擦干净受伤的地方，防止感染。
sentences.l1: There are also disinfectant wipes, which can wipe the injured place clean and prevent infection.

sentences.l2: 如果伤口有点大，可以用纱布和胶带包扎。
sentences.l1: If the wound is a bit big, you can use gauze and tape to bandage it.

sentences.l2: 运动损伤有时候会很疼，所以也可以放一些止痛药。
sentences.l1: Sports injuries sometimes hurt a lot, so you can also put in some painkillers.

sentences.l2: 最重要的，是要知道怎么用急救包里的东西。
sentences.l1: The most important thing is to know how to use the things in the first-aid kit.

sentences.l2: 如果伤得很严重，一定要请大人帮忙，或者去医院。
sentences.l1: If the injury is very serious, you must ask an adult for help, or go to the hospital.

sentences.l2: 准备好急救包，让运动更安全。
sentences.l1: Prepare the first-aid kit well, to make sports safer.
